column2:
Every talent and every rank now comes from the WoW Forever beta client, build 1.60.1.69876, instead of stream footage. Nothing is estimated anymore.

  • New: Flawless Execution (Rogue, Combat) and Wrack (Warlock, Affliction).
  • Gone: Vitality (Warrior), Restless Blades (Rogue), Drain Hope (Warlock), Balance of Nature (Druid).
  • Moved: Bastion and Focused Rage in Warrior Protection. Totemic Focus and Tidal Mastery swapped places in Shaman Restoration.
  • Arrows: Aggression no longer needs Hack and Slash, and Conflagrate no longer needs Shadowburn. Priest's Shadow Magic tab is Shadow now, Shaman's Elemental Combat is Elemental.
  • Icons: 73 talents now show the client's own icon.
  • Racials: every racial's text and icon is the client's now too, including the class variants of Eureka! and Expansive Mind.
  • Old links and saved builds are translated by talent name, so nothing you shared breaks.

The spellbook still comes from demo footage. It gets its own beta pass once I can check it in game.
A bolt that is both Fire and Frost. Four talents mention it.
A burst of Holy energy fills the caster, increasing armor by 1,170. Each melee or ranged damage hit against the priest will remove one charge. Lasts 10 min or until 20 charges are used.
A burst of Holy energy fills the caster, increasing armor by 315. Each melee or ranged damage hit against the priest will remove one charge. Lasts 10 min or until 20 charges are used.
A defensive combat stance. Decreases damage taken by 10% and damage caused by 10%. Increases all threat generated by 30%.

A free addon is in the works so your plan comes with you into the game: the same trees, your build level by level, and your next point one click away. You get a say in what it does. There is an early look, seven ideas to mark helpful or not for me, and one box for anything else. Say what would help you. It takes about a minute, and there is no sign-up.
A normal Shadow spell now, not an Undead racial. Rank 3 by 38, 1 min cooldown.

A passive in the Arms tab now, not a talent. You keep up to 10 Rage when you change stances on your own, and the Arms talent Improved Tactical Mastery adds up to 15 more. Read off Soda's Warrior video via a reader.
A powerful prayer that heals the target and their party for 179 to 191. Party members must be within 40 yards of target.
A quick kick that injures a single foe for 15 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

A reader hovered Trueshot Aura with Compare on and got raw override tags in the Classic text. The Classic reference came from Wowhead pages that carry Season of Discovery tweaks inline, and 20 talents had them: Trueshot Aura, Mortal Shots, Booming Voice, Natural Weapons and others. Every Classic text is vanilla now. u/Darkthor69 caught it.

A reader noticed Puncturing Wounds kept 10% and 5% crit at every rank. Our rank estimator only scaled the combo point chance. Fixed, and the same mistake was caught on Natural Reaction, Serrated Blades, Resourcefulness, Aftermath, Winter's Chill and a few others. Estimates now round the way Classic does (17/33/50 instead of 17/34/51), fill in between two read ranks instead of stretching one, and no longer cap Predatory Strikes at 100%. Estimated ranks are still marked Estimated.

A reader noticed the Classic text had gone missing from compare tooltips. Tonight's confirmed-rank data stored some talents differently and the compare block was reading the wrong rank. Fixed: Classic and Forever side by side again, with the changes highlighted, on desktop and in the phone sheet. Also on phones, spellbook tooltips now open as a sheet at the bottom of the screen instead of getting cut off inside the book. And the raw data now carries a CC BY 4.0 licence: use it however you like, credit talentsforever.com with a link.

A shared build's link is about a third the length it was. The order you placed the points in still travels with it, just written more tightly, and every link made before today still opens, saved builds included. A link to the site or a build shows one card in Discord now, not two cropped ones. Adding builds from pasted links used to keep only the three trees, which dropped the leveling order and could land a few classes' points on the wrong talents. Fixed.
A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.
A slow casting spell that heals a single target for 1,065 to 1,191.
A slow casting spell that heals a single target for 819 to 919.

A spell now, not a totem: 30 yd range, instant, 10 sec cooldown, and it blasts everything within 10 yd of your active Fire totem (rank 3 does 206 to 231 at 38). Improved Fire Nova trims 2 sec off the cooldown. Read on Esfand's stream.
A spellbook tooltip

A stinging shot that puts the target to sleep for 12 sec. Any damage will cancel the effect. When the target wakes up, the Sting causes 300 Nature damage over 6 sec. Only usable out of combat. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on the target at a time.
A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.
A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 40 damage and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.
A strike that deals 125% weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo point.
A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 10 to the target and a second nearby enemy.
A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 160 to 192 Fire damage, and dazing them for 6 sec.
A word of dark binding that inflicts 293 to 311 Shadow damage to the target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 10% of your maximum health.
Absorbs 120 physical damage, draining mana instead. Drains 2 mana per damage absorbed. Lasts 1 min.
Absorbs 162 Fire damage. Lasts 30 sec.
Absorbs 290 shadow damage. Lasts 30 sec.
Adds a chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 30%. Lasts 1.50 sec.
Afflicts the target with a disease that causes 128 Shadow damage over 24 sec. Damage caused by the Devouring Plague heals the caster.

Afflicts the target with impending doom, causing 1,742 Shadow damage after 1 min. If the target dies from this damage, there is a chance that a Doomguard will be summoned. Cannot be cast on players. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.
Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 1 min.
After killing an opponent that yields experience or honor, gives you a 20% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.
All spell criticals against you cause 15% of the damage taken to the caster as well. The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.
All three weapon lines now scale with rank, not just the sword one. u/AARespect caught it. Still an estimate from the rank 1 tooltip until the beta.

Allows the caster to levitate, floating a few feet above the ground. While levitating, you will fall at a reduced speed and travel over water-like surfaces. Mounting or any damage taken will cancel the effect. Lasts 2 min.
Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min. Will not work if the target is in another instance or on another continent.
Allows the friendly target to detect greater invisibility for 10 min.
Allows the friendly target to detect lesser invisibility for 10 min.
Allows the rogue to vanish from sight, entering an improved stealth mode for 10 sec. Also breaks movement impairing effects. More effective than Vanish (Rank 1).
Allows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana.
Also half a second faster: rank 1 is a 2 sec cast, 6 sec cooldown, 3 targets, each jump 30% weaker. Max Elemental Alacrity brings Lightning Bolt to the same 2 sec.
Amplifies magic used against the targeted party member, increasing damage taken from spells by up to 113 and healing spells by up to 225. Lasts 10 min.
An aggressive stance. Critical strike chance increased by 3% and all damage taken is increased by 10%.
An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 125. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.
An instant attack that lashes the target, causing 16 Shadow damage.
An instant strike that causes 10 damage in addition to your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point.
An instant strike that damages the opponent and causes the target to hemorrhage, increasing any Physical damage dealt to the target by up to 3. Lasts 30 charges or 15 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

Applies Light's Vigil to the target for 30 sec. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes allied targets to heal their party for 486 to 514, or enemy targets to suffer 268 to 288 Holy damage and refund 75% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost. You may only have 1 Light's Vigil active per Paladin, per party.
